task.question: What date in April 2026 did Artemis II become the farthest human spaceflight in history?
task.evidence: On 1 April 2026, NASA launched the Artemis II mission on the Space Launch System, sending astronauts around the Moon on a ten-day lunar flyby. On 6 April, Artemis II became the farthest human spaceflight in history when it surpassed the previous distance record of Apollo 13. The mission's re-entry capsule Integrity safely splashed down in the Pacific Ocean southwest of San Diego on 11 April 2026.
